name: A Fine Egg
summary: Curgle Cranklehop speaks of the fine egg, which stands a chance of hatching free of the Gordunni ogres' evil incantations.

sections.title: What Makes It Fine
sections.body: Curgle Cranklehop describes a fine egg as one with a good chance of hatching untouched by the wicked chanting of the Gordunni ogres, provided conditions are ideal.

sections.title: What Curgle Does Next
sections.body: Curgle takes the egg and plans to send it to Darnassus, where it is hoped that it will soon hatch.

faq.q: What makes an egg considered a fine egg?
faq.answer: With ideal conditions it can hatch free of the evil that Gordunni ogre incantations bring.
